overview.description: The Corgi GOOGL 2x Daily ETF (GOGL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in communication services equity. The Corgi GOOGL 2x Daily ETF (the Fund) seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily performance of the publicly-traded common stock of Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ: GOOGL) (Alphabet or the Underlying Security). GOGL was launched on Jun 26, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
